title: Secret round trip
summary: The agent must move a hard-coded API key into a secrets file. It writes the real key to disk without the remote model ever seeing it.

steps.raw: Fix the "known debt" in the README: move the API key out of digest/client.py into config/secrets.json and load it from there. Make `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` pass.
steps.sanitized: Fix the "known debt" in the README: move the API key out of digest/client.py into config/secrets.json and load it from there. Make `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` pass.

steps.raw:
"""OpenRouter client for the morning digest."""
import json
import urllib.request

API_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"
API_KEY = "sk-or-v1-FAKE5e2b7a90c4d1f8e36a0b9c7d2e4f1a8b3c6d9e0f2a5b8c1d4e7f0a3b6c9"  # TODO: move to config/secrets.json


def complete(prompt: str) -> str:
    req = urllib.request.Request(API_URL, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"})
    ...
